spec_dod.text: Sending a `welcome` notification to `user-1` over email succeeds and is recorded as delivered.
A transient send failure is retried up to 3 times before being marked permanently failed.
A recipient who has opted out of `welcome` notifications never receives one, regardless of trigger.
A successfully delivered notification is recorded exactly once in the delivery log — a retried-then-succeeded send does not double-log.
